fields.title: Number of hidden layers
fields.description: Specifies the number of hidden layers in the architecture of the neural network.

fields.title: Number of hidden neurons per layer
fields.description: Specifies the number of neurons contained in each hidden layer.

fields.title: Class column
fields.description:
Choose the column that contains the target variable: it can either be nominal or numerical. All
nominal class values are extracted and assigned to output neurons. If you use a numerical target
variable (regression), please make sure it is normalized!
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Ignore missing values
fields.description: If this checkbox is set, rows with missing values will not be used for training.

fields.title: Use seed for random initialization
fields.description: If this checkbox is set, a seed can be set for initializing the weights and thresholds.

fields.title: Random seed
fields.description: Seed for the random number generator.

fields.title: New
fields.description: Generate a random seed and set it in the Random seed input above for reproducible runs.
